slots_and_copies.name: global_header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Always at offset 0, single copy, no backup. Valid iff first 8 bytes are '4100ABGE' and the u16 sum over 16 bytes is 0 (FUN_0803ade8 returns 0; 2=bad magic, 1=bad checksum).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Valid/selectable iff u16 sum over all 2720 bytes == 0 (FUN_0803acf8 sets flag at SaveMgr+0x44+0). No mirroring or backup copy.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Valid/selectable iff u16 sum over all 2720 bytes == 0 (FUN_0803acf8 sets flag at SaveMgr+0x44+1). No mirroring or backup copy.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Valid/selectable iff u16 sum over all 2720 bytes == 0 (FUN_0803acf8 sets flag at SaveMgr+0x44+2). No mirroring or backup copy.

slots_and_copies.name: tail_unused
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Remainder 8192-16-3*2720=16 bytes at 0x1FF0. Never written (0xFF in both samples), no traced reader or writer.

checksums.name: global_header_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Code (FUN_0803ad80): sum of eight native u16 words over the 16-byte header, mod 65536; checksum word at +0xE stored as -sum(first 7 words) by FUN_0803ada4/FUN_0803a8b0, so valid iff total sum == 0 (FUN_0803ade8). In .sav file order the identical relation holds with big-endian u16 words (file bytes 07 0A = 0x070A = -sum of first seven BE words): the EEPROM bitstream pack/unpack (FUN_08045ba8/FUN_08045ae4, MSB-first descending) swaps each u16's bytes between RAM and the .sav representation. Little-endian applied directly to file bytes fails (sum 0x00FF). No seed, no CRC.

checksums.name: slot_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: FUN_0803acf8 requires FUN_0803ad80 sum of u16 words over the full 2720-byte slot == 0, and records the result at SaveMgr+0x44+slot_index. The word stamped as -sum by the (untraced) slot writer is unknown; last word of slot (slot+0xA9E) is a hypothesis by analogy with the global header. On both samples every slot sums to 0xFAB8 (file big-endian-word form; 0xFF-filled words are palindromic so endianness is moot), i.e. correctly invalid/empty.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 primitive: sets DMA src/dst regs, control = count&0xFFFF | 0x80000000 (enable), polls control-high 0x8000 busy bit, restores saved control register. Register addresses are unresolved _DAT_ literals; consistent with DMA3 at 0x040000D4.

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: start+read opcode bits (1,1) + address bits (count at type+8), DMA addr_bits+3 halfwords to 0x0D000000, DMA 0x44 halfwords back (4 dummy + 64 data), unpacks MSB-first into 4 u16 descending from buf+6. Bounds-checks block index against *(u16*)(type+4).

EEPROM write one 8-byte block: start+write opcode bits (1,0), 64 data bits then address bits, DMA addr_bits+0x43 halfwords to 0x0D000000, then polls (0x0D000000 & 1) ready line with timer bail-out >0x88 ticks, gated by wait flag param_3.
Read-back verify: reads block via 0x08045ae4, compares 4 u16s, returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch.
Write gate: calls 0x08045ba8(addr,data,0) only if *(int*)(*_DAT_08045dc8) != 0x200 (compared quantity unresolved).
Verified write: up to 3 rounds of write (0x08045da0) + verify (0x08045d08), break when both return 0. No callgraph caller; reached via func_ reference from 0x08008fe8.
EEPROM type/config select for param 4 / 0x40 / other; called with 0x40 by the detect function.
EEPROM detect/open: saves two registers, calls func_0x08045a1c(0x40), returns result==0. Mapped from body func_ reference (callgraph lists no callees).
EEPROM close: restores the two registers saved by 0x08009054.
Block read(byte_off, byte_len, dst): off>>3 = block, len>>3 = blocks; per 8-byte block calls func_0x08045ae4 with retry counter 3; bracketed by 0x08009054/0x0800909c; returns 1 on success.
Block write(byte_off, byte_len, src): per 8-byte block calls func_0x08045dd8 (write+verify), up to 3 retries per block; bracketed by 0x08009054/0x0800909c; returns 1 on success.
Sum16 primitive: s=0; for i in (byte_len>>1) down to 1: s += *p++. Only checksum-shaped routine in the 337-function corpus (no CRC/XOR/byte-sum found). Callers mapped via func_ references.
Global validate: reads 16 bytes at EEPROM 0, compares bytes 0..7 to template, returns 2 (bad magic) / 1 (bad sum) / 0 (valid).
Global default-write: memcpy 16-byte ROM template (0x08033d94), stamps word[7] = -sum, writes via 0x08008fe8(0,0x10).

Global flush-if-changed: reads EEPROM global to stack, zeroes +0xE, stamps -FUN_0803ad80(mgr,0x10) at +0xE, dword-compares RAM vs EEPROM copy, writes via 0x08008fe8 only if different; returns 1 if written.
Slot read: FUN_08008f80((slot*0x154+2)*8, 0xAA0, slot_buffer) = byte offset 0x10+slot*0xAA0, length 0xAA0.
Slot validate: flag at SaveMgr+0x44+slot = (FUN_0803ad80(slot_buffer, 0xAA0) == 0); returns flag.

Stream reader: memcpy dst from cursor at SaveMgr+0x4C, cursor += len; if *(SaveMgr+0x50) > 0 first advances cursor by 1 and clears state. Used by 0x0802cfdc to copy a slot's first 16 bytes into its per-slot record.
Settings save: packs settings +0x2A/+0x2B/+0x2C(bit7)/+0x2D and masked u16 at +0x2E into global bytes 0x08..0x0D, sets +0x0B=1, then func_0x0803fd40, func_0x0803a8b0 (stamp+flush), func_0x0803fd4c.
Settings load: inverse of 0x0802cd7c (global 0x08->settings+0x2A, 0x09->+0x2B, 0x0D>>7->+0x2C, 0x0A->+0x2D, u16 at 0x0C & 0x7FFF -> +0x2E). No traced caller.

fields.name: magic
fields.update_mechanism: Constant template bytes copied by FUN_0803ada4 on default-header rewrite; byte-compared against ROM template by FUN_0803ade8 on every load. SaveMgr struct offset +0x00 (absolute RAM base unresolved in corpus).
fields.evidence: Both .sav files start 34 31 30 30 41 42 47 45; FUN_0803ade8 loops iVar3 0..7 comparing read bytes to _DAT_0803ae30 and returns 2 on mismatch.

fields.name: global_settings_byte_a
fields.update_mechanism: Packed from settings object +0x2A by FUN_0802cd7c, unpacked to +0x2A by FUN_0802cd48, flushed by FUN_0803a8b0. The settings byte is adjusted by +/-1 in menu branches of FUN_080371b8 via func_0x0802d094/func_0x0802d0c4. File-byte vs RAM-byte +8/+9 identity may be swapped (see checksum byte-order note); role is static-confirmed, exact file position is the hypothesis.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+8) = *(settings+0x2A); FUN_0802cd48 inverse. Observed file byte 0x08 changed 0x0C->0x0B between samples; traced writer cannot be proven to have produced this change (byte 0x0B contradiction).

fields.name: global_settings_byte_b
fields.update_mechanism: Packed from settings object +0x2B by FUN_0802cd7c, unpacked by FUN_0802cd48; +/-1 menu adjusters as for byte A. May swap file position with offset 8 under the EEPROM word byte-swap.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+9) = *(settings+0x2B); FUN_080371b8 branches adjust byte at settings+0x2B via func_0x0802d094/func_0x0802d0c4 with +/-1.

fields.name: global_settings_byte_c
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0802cd7c packs settings+0x2D here; FUN_0803a978 stores FUN_08040f68() (a stored byte, plausibly language/locale index in the 5-language title) at SaveMgr+0x0A; FUN_0803a91c dispatches FUN_08040ef0 on this byte at load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+10) = *(settings+0x2D); FUN_0803a978: *(mgr+10) = FUN_08040f68(); FUN_080371b8 writes settings+0x2D = item-0x42 before calling FUN_0802cd7c.

fields.name: global_initialized_marker
fields.update_mechanism: Set to constant 1 by both traced writers before flushing. Observed 0 in both samples, proving those writers did not flush these samples (or had not run); semantic name unknown.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+0xB) = 1; FUN_0803a978: *(mgr+0xB) = 1. File bytes 0x0A and 0x0B are both 0x00 in both samples under either byte-order hypothesis.

fields.name: global_settings_bitfield_u16
fields.update_mechanism: RAM u16 at global+0x0C: FUN_0802cd7c stores (maskA & old) | (maskB & *(u16*)(settings+0x2E)) with unresolved masks, and separately drives bit 7 of the high byte (file offset 0x0D) from settings+0x2C. FUN_0802cd48 recovers settings+0x2E = value & 0x7FFF and settings+0x2C = high byte >> 7. Observed change is file byte 0x0C 0x00->0x01 (low bit); producing writer untraced for these samples.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c masked-merge lines and *(byte*)(global+0xD) = &0x7F | settings[0x2C]<<7; FUN_0802cd48: *(u16*)(settings+0x2E) = *(u16*)(global+0xC) & 0x7FFF. Role static-confirmed; observed-change attribution is hypothesis.

fields.name: global_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed on every global flush: word = -sum of the other seven u16 words (FUN_0803ad80). File order stores it big-endian (0x070A); RAM form is little-endian at SaveMgr+0x0E. Never written by gameplay/menu code directly.
fields.evidence: Python verification on both samples: sum of eight BE u16 words = 0x0000, stored BE word 0x070A == -sum(first seven BE words) 0x070A. LE on file bytes fails (sum 0x00FF). Code: FUN_0803ada4 mgr[7]=-sum; FUN_0803a8b0 zeroes +0xE, stamps -FUN_0803ad80(mgr,0x10).

fields.name: slot0_header
fields.update_mechanism: First 16 bytes of slot 0 (slot buffer +0x00). Zero-written by FUN_0803a91c on bad-magic init; copied into per-slot RAM record at SaveMgr+0x14 by FUN_0802cfdc/FUN_0803a9f8 at load. In-game writer missing from corpus; internal field split unknown.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a91c loop FUN_08008fe8(0x10+slot*0xAA0, 0x10, zeroed buffer); FUN_0803ac9c calls FUN_0802cfdc(mgr+0x14+slot*0x10) after loading each slot.

fields.name: slot1_header
fields.update_mechanism: As slot0_header, at slot 1 base 0xAB0; per-slot record at SaveMgr+0x24.
fields.evidence: Same FUN_0803a91c/FUN_0803ac9c code paths with slot index 1; file range 0xAB0..0xABF is 16 zero bytes in both samples.

fields.name: slot2_header
fields.update_mechanism: As slot0_header, at slot 2 base 0x1550; per-slot record at SaveMgr+0x34.
fields.evidence: Same code paths with slot index 2; file range 0x1550..0x155F is 16 zero bytes in both samples.

fields.name: slot_payload
fields.update_mechanism: Slot buffer +0x10..+0xA9F of each 0xAA0 slot (file offsets slot_base+16 .. slot_base+0xA9F). Read in full by FUN_0803ad28 and covered by the FUN_0803acf8 checksum; sequential deserialization via the FUN_0803a9f8 cursor. No writer/serializer in corpus; offsets given for slot 0, add 2720 per slot.
fields.evidence: No function calls FUN_08008fe8 with length 0xAA0 and no field reader beyond the header copy exists in decompiled.c; samples contain only 0xFF here, so no field subdivision is derivable.

fields.name: slot_checksum_candidate
fields.update_mechanism: Hypothesized stamped word at slot+0xA9E (file offset shown for slot 0; add 2720 per slot), by analogy with the global header's last-word checksum. Verified facts are only the covered range (full slot) and the sum==0 validity rule in FUN_0803acf8; the stamper and its offset are not in the corpus.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803acf8: *(bool*)(mgr+0x44+slot) = (FUN_0803ad80(slot_buffer, 0xAA0) == 0). Both samples sum to 0xFAB8 per slot (invalid/empty), consistent with never-written 0xFF payload.

fields.name: tail_unused
fields.update_mechanism: Arithmetic remainder 8192 - 16 - 3*2720 at 0x1FF0; no traced access.
fields.evidence: Geometry derived from FUN_0803ad28 offset formula (0x10 + slot*0xAA0, size 0xAA0) exhausts the file except these 16 bytes; full-corpus constant search found no accessor.

open_questions: Where is the in-game slot writer/serializer and slot checksum stamper? Not in the 337 traced functions (no 0xAA0-length FUN_08008fe8 call, no slot -sum store); a fuller decompilation or runtime trace of a real save action is needed.
What are the slot payload fields (slot+0x10..+0xA9D)? Both samples are empty (0xFF); a progressed save file is required.

What is the absolute EWRAM base address of the save-manager struct and of the settings object? All _DAT_ literals are unresolved in this corpus, so only struct-relative offsets (+0x00 global, +0x10 slot buffer, +0x14 records, +0x44 valid flags, +0x4C cursor, +0x50 state) are known.

Is the file-to-RAM per-word byte swap real, i.e. do RAM bytes +8/+9 map to file bytes 0x09/0x08? The global checksum verifies only in big-endian file-word form while the code sums native little-endian RAM words; fuzzing offsets 8 and 9 settles which menu setting each file byte is.
Why is file byte 0x0B = 0 although FUN_0802cd7c and FUN_0803a978 set RAM +0x0B = 1, and which writer produced the observed inter-sample changes at 0x08 (-1) and 0x0C (+1)?

What is the 0x200-compared quantity gating writes in FUN_08045da0, the exact EEPROM type word at type+4 / address-bit count at type+8 (expected 1024 blocks / 14 bits for 8 KB), and the two masks in the FUN_0802cd7c u16 merge?
What are the menu identities of settings bytes +0x2A, +0x2B, +0x2C, +0x2D and of the 0x0C bitfield (fuzzing offsets 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 settles them)?

How does the full game handle FUN_0803ade8 return 1 (bad checksum) versus return 2 (bad magic)? The packet cold-reload probe mutated offset 0x8 without a blank-revert or rewrite, which is only partly explained by the traced FUN_0803a91c condition.
